strings.name: Paulo Coelho
strings.summary: Born in Rio de Janeiro, Coelho worked in theatre, journalism and songwriting, collaborated with Raul Seixas and was detained under military rule. His 1986 Santiago pilgrimage helped turn him toward literature, represented by The Pilgrimage and The Alchemist. His fable-like works on personal quests, faith and choice circulate widely in translation. He joined the Brazilian Academy of Letters in 2002, while critical assessments of his literary work remain divided.
